main-quest:Captured Memories: (Unverified) Visit the 12 photo locations from the Sheikah Slate album. Enable Memories in the map Legend to see them; stand where the photo was taken.
main-quest:Destroy Ganon: King Rhoam's ghost gives this after The Isolated Plateau. Enter Hyrule Castle at any time and defeat Calamity Ganon; freed Divine Beasts weaken him.
main-quest:Divine Beast Vah Medoh: (Unverified) Talk to Kaneli in Rito Village, then Saki next door. Find Teba at the Flight Range and take on Vah Medoh using the Rito flight launch.
main-quest:Divine Beast Vah Naboris: Talk to Riju, then see Teake at the barracks. Beat Master Kohga in the Yiga Hideout for the Thunder Helm, return it to Riju, then meet her at the Lookout Tower.
main-quest:Divine Beast Vah Rudania: Talk to Bludo in Goron City, free Yunobo at the Abandoned North Mine, then cross Bridge of Eldin with him. Wear fire resistance and beat Fireblight Ganon inside.
main-quest:Divine Beast Vah Ruta: (Unverified) Talk to Muzu in Zora's Domain, gather 20 Shock Arrows near Ploymus Mountain, then join Sidon at East Reservoir Lake to take on Vah Ruta.
main-quest:EX Champion Daruk's Song: Hear Kass's song at the stone monument across Golow River, SW of Goron City. Clear the three clue shrines in any order, then beat Fireblight Ganon at Vah Rudania.
main-quest:EX Champion Mipha's Song: (Unverified) Trigger by hearing Kass's song at the monument near Lanayru. Clear the three clue shrines in any order, then beat Waterblight Ganon at Vah Ruta.
main-quest:EX Champion Revali's Song: (Unverified) Trigger by hearing Kass's song at the monument in Hebra. Clear the three clue shrines in any order, then beat Windblight Ganon at Vah Medoh.
main-quest:EX Champion Urbosa's Song: Trigger at the monument on East Gerudo Mesa, SE of Vah Naboris. Clear the three clue shrines in any order, then beat Thunderblight Ganon.
main-quest:EX Champions' Ballad: After freeing all four Divine Beasts, talk to Zelda and head to the Shrine of Resurrection. Clear the four Champion song quests, then the final trial vs Monk Maz Koshia.
main-quest:Find the Fairy Fountain: (Unverified) Talk to Pikango in Kakariko Village and take Camera pictures matching his clues, then find the Great Fairy Fountain near Kakariko.
main-quest:Follow the Sheikah Slate: Grab the Slate, exit the shrine, and follow the marker past the Old Man to the Great Plateau Tower. Activate it to finish.
main-quest:Forbidden City Entry: (Unverified) Talk to Benja, buy the Gerudo outfit from Vilia on top of the Kara Kara Bazaar inn, wear it and walk into Gerudo Town.
main-quest:Free the Divine Beasts: (Unverified) Given by Impa. Free all four Divine Beasts (Rudania, Medoh, Ruta, Naboris) in any order, then report to each elder.
main-quest:Locked Mementos: (Unverified) Go to the Ancient Tech Lab in Hateno Village and talk to Purah/Robbie to get the Sheikah Slate's camera rune; then find the photo locations for Captured Memories.
main-quest:Reach Zora's Domain: (Unverified) Follow Prince Sidon from Inogo Bridge north along the Zora River to Zora's Domain.
main-quest:Seek Out Impa: Head east past Dueling Peaks Stable, then north to Kakariko Village. Talk to Impa at her house to finish.
main-quest:The Hero's Sword: Reach Korok Forest via the Lost Woods and try pulling the Master Sword. You need 13 hearts, so hold to pull it free.
main-quest:The Isolated Plateau: After the tower, talk to the Old Man. Clear the four Plateau shrines, collect the spirit orbs, then visit the Temple of Time to get the Paraglider from King Rhoam.
memory:Memory01: Stand on the circular stone-paved area at Sacred Ground Ruins, on the road in front of Hyrule Castle Town. Beware Guardians.
memory:Memory02: (Unverified) Unlocked by freeing Divine Beast Vah Medoh in the Tabantha region. The Revali cutscene plays on completion.
memory:Memory03: Head to the west shore of Lake Kolomo, in the tree grove. Look for the boulder pointing up toward the lake, and line up Picture 2. Easy early after getting the paraglider.
memory:Memory04: Free Yunobo from the Abandoned North Mine, then talk to Bludo in Goron City. He points out the Daruk statue, which triggers the memory.
memory:Memory05: Go to the Tabantha Great Bridge area, on the way to Tena Ko'sah Shrine. Match Picture 3; the Sheikah Sensor helps pinpoint the spot.
memory:Memory06: Unlocked by freeing Divine Beast Vah Naboris during the Divine Beasts quest. The cutscene plays after you finish it.
memory:Memory07: Go to Kara Kara Bazaar in the Gerudo Desert, to the northeast side of the oasis. Match the Yiga ambush spot in Picture 4.
memory:Memory08: Go to Eldin Canyon, west of Goronbi Lake (near Eldin Tower). Stand by the lone tree beside the pond and match Picture 5.
memory:Memory09: Go to Irch Plain, southeast of Salari Hill, northwest of Hyrule Castle. Stand by the lone tree and Silent Princess flowers next to the small lake and match Picture 6.
memory:Memory10: Unlocked by freeing Divine Beast Vah Ruta during the Divine Beasts quest. The Mipha cutscene plays on completion.
memory:Memory11: (Unverified) Look for the two bird-like stone statues and a large tree on a small hill by the Hylia River, east of the Great Plateau, with Bridge of Hylia in view. Match Picture 7.
memory:Memory12: Sneak into Hyrule Castle's left wing and stand on the bridge between Zelda's room tower and the next tower. Avoid Guardians.
memory:Memory13: Go to the Spring of Power in Akkala, in the quarry hole west of East Akkala Stable. Stand before the Goddess statue's stone platform for the cutscene.
memory:Memory14: (Unverified) Go to Sanidin Park Ruins on Hyrule Ridge (sources conflict; horse statue is the photo landmark). Stand by the large horse statue and match the photo to trigger it.
memory:Memory15: Go to Lanayru Road East Gate, west of Mount Lanayru before Naydra Snowfield. Match the Picture 11 vista to trigger the memory.
memory:Memory16: Go to the grove northeast of the Bottomless Swamp, west of the Hylia River. Match the rain-soaked clearing in Picture 12 to trigger it.
memory:Memory17: Go to the middle of Ash Swamp on Blatchery Plain, near Fort Hateno. Impa reveals this after you recover the other memories; match Picture 13.
memory:Memory18: Pull the Master Sword from its pedestal in Korok Forest (needs 13 hearts). The memory plays automatically on drawing it.
memory:MemoryEX01: (Unverified) Free Vah Medoh, then find Kass in the Hebra region to start his song. Beat Windblight Ganon again in the Illusory Realm to unlock the memory.
memory:MemoryEX02: Free Vah Rudania first, then find the stone monument near Golow River with Kass. Play it to unlock the song, then beat Fireblight Ganon again in the Illusory Realm.
memory:MemoryEX03: (Unverified) Free Vah Ruta, then find Kass in Lanayru to learn Mipha's song. Beat Waterblight Ganon again in the Illusory Realm to unlock the memory.
memory:MemoryEX04: (Unverified) Free Vah Naboris, then find Kass in the Gerudo Desert. Follow him to the Champion Urbosa's Song monument and play through the song; defeat Thunderblight Ganon again.
memory:MemoryEX05: (Unverified) Champions' Ballad memory is unlocked after completing the Champions' Ballad DLC; use the Slate's picture spot in Hyrule Castle Town ruins to view it.
quest-objective:A Fragmented Monument Ob: At Palmorae Ruins (east of Lurelin), photograph the fragment behind the three palm trees, then show Garini.
Head left toward Soka Point and photograph the fragment by the crates in the water between rocks.
Photograph the last fragment on Soka Point and return to Garini; then crouch on an orange platform to reveal Kah Yah Shrine.
quest-objective:A Wife Washed Away Objec: (Unverified) Talk to Fronk in Zora's Domain, then search the river and lake for his wife Laruta, who was swept away; check Lanayru.
quest-objective:Destroy Ganon objective: (Unverified) Talk to the Old Man after leaving the Plateau; the quest is to defeat Calamity Ganon in Hyrule Castle, best done after freeing the Divine Beasts.
quest-objective:Divine Beast Vah Medoh F: (Unverified) Talk to Kaneli, then Saki next door, then go to the Flight Range in Hebra and find Teba to continue the Vah Medoh quest.
quest-objective:Divine Beast Vah Naboris: (Unverified) Recover the Thunder Helm for Riju, then meet her at the Lookout Tower to start the approach to Vah Naboris.
quest-objective:Divine Beast Vah Rudania: (Unverified) Return to Bludo in Goron City, then meet Yunobo at the Bridge of Eldin and ride his cannon to Vah Rudania.
(Unverified) Talk to Drak at the Abandoned North Mine entrance in Eldin; he says Yunobo is trapped inside, so head into the mine.
(Unverified) Enter the Abandoned North Mine, fight through to the end and free Yunobo from the Igneo Talus boss area, then return to Bludo.
quest-objective:Divine Beast Vah Ruta Pr: (Unverified) Talk to Muzu in Zora's Domain, collect 20 Shock Arrows around Ploymus Mountain, then meet Prince Sidon at East Reservoir Lake.
quest-objective:From the Ground Up Objec: (Unverified) Talk to Hudson in Hateno Village (after Hylian Homeowner), then help build Tarrey Town in Akkala by recruiting residents and delivering materials.
quest-objective:Hunt for the Giant Horse: (Unverified) Talk to Straia at the Mounted Archery Camp in Faron, then find the giant white stallion in the nearby Faron grasslands/Hyrule region at night.
quest-objective:Locked Mementos Ancient: Take the Blue Flame to the furnace outside Hateno Ancient Tech Lab; Purah then restores your Slate's Camera Rune. Report to Impa.
quest-objective:Obtain the Master Sword: (Unverified) Go to the Lost Woods and pull the Master Sword from its pedestal in the Korok Forest; you need 13 hearts, or more, to draw it.
quest-objective:Seek Out Impa objective: Head east to Kakariko Village past the Dueling Peaks and speak to Impa in the large hall at the top.
quest-objective:Special Delivery Objecti: (Unverified) Talk to Finley at the Bank of Wishes in Eldin after freeing Vah Ruta, then deliver his package to the named recipient.
quest-objective:The Eighth Heroine Objec: (Unverified) Talk to Bozai in Gerudo Desert, then bring the Camera rune, Gerudo Veil, Top and Sirwal to dress and pose for a statue photo.
quest-objective:The Forgotten Sword Obje: (Unverified) Talk to Bozai in Gerudo Desert after unlocking the Forbidden City and The Eighth Heroine; he tells you about a lost sword to retrieve.
quest-objective:The Weapon Connoisseur O: (Unverified) Show Nebb in Hateno Village the full set: Traveler's Sword, Fire Rod, Moblin Club, Duplex Bow, Windcleaver, Ancient Battle Axe+, Frostspear, Ancient Short Sword.
(Unverified) Show Nebb in Hateno Village the full set: Traveler's Sword, Fire Rod, Moblin Club, Duplex Bow, Windcleaver, Ancient Battle Axe+, Frostspear, Ancient Short Sword.
(Unverified) Show Nebb in Hateno Village the full set: Traveler's Sword, Fire Rod, Moblin Club, Duplex Bow, Windcleaver, Ancient Battle Axe+, Frostspear, Ancient Short Sword.
(Unverified) Show Nebb in Hateno Village the full set: Traveler's Sword, Fire Rod, Moblin Club, Duplex Bow, Windcleaver, Ancient Battle Axe+, Frostspear, Ancient Short Sword.
quest-objective:Zora Stone Monuments Obj: Glide down the cliff north of Vah Ruta into the Lizalfos valley near Oren Bridge. Read the monument (Part One).
Southeast of Upland Zorana: cross the bridge, climb the east waterfall, glide down left from the cliff top. Read the Memoir; then see Jiahto.
Southeast of Part One: drop north of Vah Ruta and follow the valley to a ledge. Read Part Two.
East of Ralis Pond: from Dagah Keek Shrine, go up left to a ledge, drop and glide along the cliff wall. Read Part Three.
Glide from Vah Ruta toward Luto's Crossing; it sits at the valley bottom, west of Ruto Mountain. Read Part Four.
West of Vah Ruta: drop toward Zodobon Highlands, descend straight down along the cliff wall. Read Part Five.
Glide northeast of Vah Ruta to a tiny cave under a cliff beside a cherry blossom tree. Read Part Six.
East of the Ruto Lake bridge: glide northeast from Vah Ruta and look under the cliff. Read Part Seven (partly missing).
Glide from Vah Ruta toward Luto's Crossing and climb the cliff marked by cherry blossoms. Read Addendum 1.
South of Lulu Lake, by a cliff wall. Wear Zora armor to climb the waterfalls. Read Addendum 2.
shrine-quest:A Brother's Roast: Get a Rock Roast (cooked rock salt) to Bladon in Goron City; his brother Gonguron breaks the wall to reveal Kayra Mah Shrine (a slope climb dodging boulders and spiked balls).
shrine-quest:A Fragmented Monument: Garini at Palmorae Ruins; needs Camera rune. Find three monument pieces (east of Garini, SW of Palmorae Beach, Soka Point), then crouch on a glowing platform.
shrine-quest:A Landscape of a Stable: Talk to Mayro at Foothill Stable; the painting shows the shrine southwest of the stable beneath the birds. Walk there and the Tah Muhl Shrine rises (bring fire).
shrine-quest:A Song of Storms: Listen to Kass near the giant mound; make lightning hit it during a storm (drop metal weapons on the mound) to shatter it and reveal Qukah Nata Shrine.
shrine-quest:Cliffside Etchings: Find the man-made etching on the Tabantha cliff face (Geggle at the stable hints at it); hit the pedestal in its middle with a shock arrow. Shrine rises.
shrine-quest:Guardian Slideshow: Talk to Loone on Puffer Beach. Photograph three Guardian types for her, return, and take the Ancient Orb to the pedestal to unlock Shoqa Tatone Shrine.
shrine-quest:Into the Vortex: Find the Stone Tablet and Ancient Orb in the ruins southeast of Malin Bay; put the orb on the pedestal to reveal Ritaag Zumo Shrine on the Rist Peninsula.
shrine-quest:Master of the Wind: (Unverified) Talk to Kass at Horon Lagoon, follow his wind riddle with bombs and updrafts, and land on the orange pedestal without touching the ground to raise the shrine.
shrine-quest:Recital at Warbler's Nest: (Unverified) After Vah Medoh, help Amali find Kheel at Warbler's Nest, then use the nest's pillar puzzle (sisters' song order) to raise Voo Lota Shrine.
shrine-quest:Secret of the Cedars: Talk to Clavia on Hateno docks. Go to the cedars on Madorna Mountain, bomb the rock wall at the entrance to reveal Tahno O'ah Shrine. Bring cold resistance.
shrine-quest:Secret of the Snowy Peaks: (Unverified) Hear Kass's song near the snowy peaks, then follow its clue at the mountain location to make Suma Sahma Shrine appear.
shrine-quest:Shrouded Shrine: Enter the dark Thyphlo Ruins north of the Lost Woods, carry the Ancient Orb (from the Blue Hinox area) to the pedestal to raise Ketoh Wawai Shrine; bring a torch.
shrine-quest:Sign of the Shadow: (Unverified) Talk to Kass atop Gerudo Tower. Stand on the metal plate at the tower's shadow point (afternoon) and shoot a fire arrow at the tower top to raise Sasa Kai Shrine.
shrine-quest:Stranded on Eventide: (Unverified) Reach Eventide Island, where all gear is lost. Collect and place the three orbs, beat the boss, to raise Korgu Chideh Shrine on Koholit Rock.
shrine-quest:Test of Will: Talk to Bayge on Mount Nabooru and finish both endurance trials (heat; use a fireproof elixir). The Joloo Nah shrine then rises from the ground.
shrine-quest:The Ancient Rito Song: After Vah Medoh, hear Bedoli's half-song, then Laissa's half. Go to the pedestal south of Rito Village and hit it with a fire arrow when the shadow's heart hole lines up.
shrine-quest:The Bird in the Mountains: Molli's riddle points to the cedar at Talonto Peak, NE of Rito Village. Glide to the cliff cave there; the shrine (Mozo Shenno, Guardian Scout fight) counts as complete.
shrine-quest:The Ceremonial Song: After Vah Ruta, talk to Laruta in Zora's Domain. At the base of Veiled Falls, strike the pedestal with the Lightscale Trident from about 5 ft above it to raise Dagah Keek Shrine.
shrine-quest:The Crowned Beast: Talk to Kass at Rabia Plain. His song means a mountain buck: tame and ride one (use stamina) to the pedestal beside Kass to raise Mezza Lo Shrine.
shrine-quest:The Cursed Statue: Talk to Doctor Calip near Fort Hateno. At night, shoot an arrow at the one statue with glowing eyes in the statue field to raise Kam Urog Shrine.
shrine-quest:The Desert Labyrinth: Enter South Lomei Labyrinth from the north and navigate the maze to its center; Dila Maag Shrine is there. A chest on the way holds Barbarian Armor.
shrine-quest:The Eye of the Sandstorm: Talk to Nobiro in Kara Kara Bazaar, then glide from the Great Cliffs into the sandstorm eye (calmer at night) toward the orange light. Dako Tah Shrine sits there.
shrine-quest:The Gut Check Challenge: Talk to Bayge or step on the shrine platform, pay 20 rupees, then climb Gut Check Rock collecting 100+ rupees before time runs out.
shrine-quest:The Lost Pilgrimage: Talk to Tasho in Korok Forest, then follow Oaki through the Lost Woods without being seen, or slip ahead. Daag Chokah Shrine rises NW; open the chest and take the orb.
shrine-quest:The Perfect Drink: Talk to Pokki at the shrine, then buy a Noble Pursuit using ice from the Northern Icehouse at the Noble Canteen in Gerudo Town. Return and tell her about it to open Misae Suma Shrine.
shrine-quest:The Serpent's Jaws: Hear Kass's song in Pagos Woods, shoot Farosh to get a scale, then offer it at the Spring of Courage statue to open the Shae Katha Shrine.
shrine-quest:The Seven Heroines: Get the quest from Rotana in Gerudo Town. In the East Gerudo Ruins, place each orb in the socket in front of its matching colored statue (rainbow order) to raise Korsh O'hu Shrine.
shrine-quest:The Silent Swordswomen: Talk to Laine at Gerudo Town's northwest gate. Follow the swordswoman statues in a straight line through the sandstorm to find Kema Zoos Shrine.
shrine-quest:The Skull's Eye: Talk to Jerrin at Akkala Ancient Tech Lab (after Robbie's Research), then glide or climb to Zuna Kai Shrine on an eye of Skull Lake.
shrine-quest:The Spring of Power: Pray at the Goddess Statue in the spring west of East Akkala Stable, then drop a Dinraal's Scale in front of it (shoot Dinraal's body near Tabantha Bridge at dawn).
shrine-quest:The Spring of Wisdom: Talk to Medda in Hateno Village. Defeat Naydra on Mount Lanayru (need cold resistance), then drop her scale in the spring to open Jitan Sa'mi Shrine.
shrine-quest:The Stolen Heirloom: Meet Dorian in Kakariko at night (after Flown the Coop, By Firefly's Light, Fairy Fountain). Follow him; kill the Yiga Blademaster, then place the orb on the pedestal.
shrine-quest:The Test of Wood: Talk to Damia in Korok Forest, then carry a wooden sword, shield and bow through the enemy gauntlet without breaking or burning them. Maag Halan Shrine rises at the end.
shrine-quest:The Three Giant Brothers: Read the tablet on Mount Taran. Take the orb from each of three Hinox (Uten Marsh, Rabella Wetlands, Hanu Pond) and place them on the pedestals to raise Tawa Jinn Shrine.
shrine-quest:The Two Rings: Listen to Kass near Jeddo Bridge, then fire one single-shot arrow through both rings from the spot he sings. The Sheem Dagoze shrine rises.
shrine-quest:The Undefeated Champ: With Vah Naboris cleared, race Shabonne (50 rupees) at the Sand-Seal Rally south of Gerudo Town in under 1:30. Put the orb you win into the pedestal to raise Raqa Zunzo Shrine.
shrine-quest:Trial of Second Sight: Talk to Zooki in Korok Forest; use Magnesis to follow the trees holding iron boulders, put a chest on the raft, row across and set it in the tree's mouth to open Kuhn Sidajj Shrine.
shrine-quest:Trial of Thunder: Reach Thundra Plateau; put all four metal orbs on their pedestals (use Stasis on the red one, shoot the rest down). The Toh Yahsa shrine rises; its chest has Rubber Armor.
shrine-quest:Trial of the Labyrinth: Clear Lomei Labyrinth Island's maze to its end to unlock Tu Ka'loh Shrine; enter via the north of the island.
shrine-quest:Trial on the Cliff: Enter the North Lomei Labyrinth in Hebra and reach its center; take the ladder to the second floor and follow the path. Bring fire weapons for the maze.
shrine-quest:Under a Red Moon: Talk to Kass atop the tallest mushroom spire in Washa's Bluff. Stand on the Mijah Rokee pedestal during a Blood Moon, wearing no armor.
shrine-quest:Watch Out for the Flowers: Talk to Magda at Floret Sandbar. Walk between the flowers (or glide over them, e.g. Revali's Gale) to reach the entrance and open Hila Rao Shrine.
shrine:Akh Va'quot Shrine: Windmills puzzle: shoot the wind switches so all six fans blow at once, which opens the gate to the monk. Southwest of Rito Village.
shrine:Bareeda Naag Shrine: (Unverified) Appears after The Ancient Rito Song quest: play along with Kass at the marked spot in Tabantha. Inside, solve the Magnesis/Stasis puzzle to reach the chest and monk.
shrine:Bosh Kala Shrine: Paraglider tutorial near Proxim Bridge: glide from the left stairs across wind currents to the chest (Soldier's Claymore) and a second chest, then talk to the monk.
shrine:Chaas Qeta Shrine: Combat trial on Tenoko Island: defeat the Guardian Scout IV (ice arrows interrupt its spin; use pillars for cover). Chest has Climbing Gear.
shrine:Daag Chokah Shrine: (Unverified) Lost Pilgrimage: follow the trail of lights/markers along the path to the shrine; once inside it's a simple walk to the monk with no puzzle.
shrine:Dagah Keek Shrine: Blessing shrine, no puzzle; chest has a Silver Rupee. Raised by The Ceremonial Song: get the Ceremonial Trident (Laruta) and ground-pound the pedestal at Veiled Falls.
shrine:Dah Hesho Shrine: Test of Strength: defeat the Guardian Scout II. Dodge its shots and strike its legs and eye; parry the spin attack.
shrine:Dah Kaso Shrine: Test of Strength: defeat the Guardian Scout II. Dodge its shots, hit its legs and eye, and parry the spin attack.
shrine:Daka Tuss Shrine: Magnesis puzzle (Sunken Scoop): use the metal scoop to carry the sphere to the cage and open the gate. Drain the water to reach the chest with a Silver Longsword.
shrine:Dako Tah Shrine: Test of Strength: beat the Guardian Scout I. Reach it by following the Eye of the Sandstorm quest; shield-jump the switch or use shock to open the door. Chest: Radiant Shield.
shrine:Daqa Koh Shrine: Get launched onto the large central block, then glide right to the chest (Silver Rupee). Talk to the monk at the altar.
shrine:Daqo Chisay Shrine: Electric puzzle at Gerudo Town entrance: use metal objects with Magnesis to bridge the current and open the doors.
shrine:Dila Maag Shrine: Complete the maze: hug the left wall; chest at the end has Barbarian Armor.
shrine:Dow Na'eh Shrine: Three Boxes: use Magnesis to put three metal boxes onto the floor switch in the water, which raises the lift to the monk. Behind the waterfall on Lanayru Promenade.
shrine:Dunba Taag Shrine: (Unverified) Puzzle shrine in Tanagar Canyon. Stasis or Octo Balloons skip both puzzles; otherwise use Stasis to move gear platforms to the exit.
shrine:Etsu Korima Shrine: Path of Light (Champions' Ballad): follow torches and glowing walls through the dark; hide from the Guardian Scout's laser, hit it with Stasis and Ancient Arrows, then take the orb upstairs.
shrine:Gee Ha'rah Shrine: Cut the rope so the round boulder hits the first switch, then use bow and arrows on the targets. Cold resistance helps outside.
shrine:Goma Asaagh Shrine: Test of Strength: fight a Guardian Scout IV. Bring strong weapons and shields and use ancient arrows or parry its beam.
shrine:Gorae Torr Shrine: Appears via The Gut Check Challenge: pay Bayge 20 rupees, then climb Gut Check Rock grabbing 100+ rupees within the time limit. Chest has a Great Frostblade.
shrine:Ha Dahamar Shrine: Cryonis puzzle (The Water Guides): make ice blocks to steer the flowing water and ball to the gate. Chest holds a Purple Rupee; shrine is just west of Dueling Peaks Stable.
shrine:Hawa Koth Shrine: Under the Gerudo Great Skeleton, through sandstorm. Shoot the first switch with a shock arrow, then beat the Guardian Scout I.
shrine:Hia Miu Shrine: Test of Strength: fight a Guardian Scout IV. Dodge its attacks, parry its beam, and hit its eye.
shrine:Hila Rao Shrine: Weave through the flower field without touching any (stay on the dirt path), or glide over with Revali's Gale. Talk to Magda for the quest.
shrine:Ishto Soh Shrine: Bravery's Grasp: carry the laser to the platform, hit the central switch with a laser or bomb to raise columns, and use Stasis on the beam to reach the Topaz chest, then go up.
shrine:Ja Baij Shrine: Bomb trial: take the Remote Bomb Rune from the pedestal, then blow open walls. Bomb the wall past the first area for a chest; ride launch blocks to the altar.
shrine:Jee Noh Shrine: East of Wasteland Tower. Shoot the targets with arrows to progress, then defeat the Guardian Scout I.
shrine:Jitan Sa'mi Shrine: Blessing, no puzzle; chest holds a Frostspear. Drop a Naydra scale into the Spring of Wisdom on Mount Lanayru to open it; bring Cold Resistance 2.
shrine:Joloo Nah Shrine: Gyro apparatus: tilt the cube to power all switches and open each gate; shoot a fire arrow at the corner chest for the Gerudo Spear. Light the six torches in the last room.
shrine:Ka'o Makagh Shrine: Use Magnesis to open the big metal doors, beat the Guardian Scouts, then move the door again as a ramp to the altar. Chest on the back left via a pulled metal block.
shrine:Kaam Ya'tak Shrine: Trial of Power: use Magnesis on the large boulder to batter the door; Stasis the wheeled hammer and strike it. Burn the leaves with fire arrows. Diamond in chest.
shrine:Kah Mael Shrine: Move the slab over the hole (Stasis/balloons). Inside, shoot the rope so the metal cube drops on the scale and launches you; glide to the chest (Diamond).
shrine:Kah Okeo Shrine: Combat shrine: defeat Guardian Scouts I and II. Stay mobile, dodge or shield, and hit the eye.
shrine:Kah Yah Shrine: Appears via A Fragmented Monument (Garini, Palmorae Ruins). Inside, carry a barrel on the moving platform to the pressure plate; chest has a Royal Claymore.
shrine:Kam Urog Shrine: Talk to Calip near Fort Hateno, wait for night, and shoot an arrow into the glowing eyes of the cursed statue to raise the shrine. Rewards include a Spirit Orb.
shrine:Kamia Omuna Shrine: DLC Moving Targets: defeat the Igneo Talus by Lake Darman to open it, then hit the glowing wall targets with the cannons to open the gates. Reward: Rudania's Emblem.
shrine:Katah Chuki Shrine: Test of Strength: defeat the Guardian Scout II. Dodge its shots, hit its legs and eye, and parry the spin attack.
shrine:Katosa Aug Shrine: Gyro golf: tilt to putt the Ancient Orb into the hole; the platform to the altar moves. A second course behind the altar needs a bank shot; chest has a Great Frostblade.
shrine:Kay Noh Shrine: (Unverified) Near the cliff above Gerudo Canyon Stable. Work through the room, then defeat the Guardian Scout I and II.
shrine:Kaya Wan Shrine: (Unverified) Water-crossing puzzle: use Cryonis ice blocks (and the raft) to cross the water; chests are reachable by ice pillars or by burning wooden platforms.
shrine:Kayra Mah Shrine: Bring Bladon's Rock Roast to Gonguron in Gorko Tunnel; he breaks the bedrock and reveals the shrine. Inside, climb the slope dodging boulders and spikes; Ruby chest halfway up.
shrine:Ke'nai Shakah Shrine: Glide into Ulria Grotto (Akkala) and bomb-arrow the cracked rocks to enter. Beat the Guardian Scout III (dodge and flurry); chest holds a Sapphire.
shrine:Kee Dafunia Shrine: DLC (Mipha's Song): fly through the glowing ring to spawn it. Light a torch at the brazier and melt the ice to progress. Reward: Ruta's Emblem.
shrine:Keeha Yoog Shrine: Shoot the centre of the cliff etching with a Shock Arrow to reveal the shrine (quest from Geggle at Tabantha Bridge Stable); chest has a Diamond.
shrine:Keh Namut Shrine: Cryonis tutorial: grab the rune, then raise ice pillars from water to reach the raised platform and pass under the gate. Optional chest holds a Traveler's Spear.
shrine:Keive Tala Shrine: DLC Pack 1 shrine, southeast of East Barrens. Use Magnesis and Cryonis; chest at the room's right end, reward Naboris's Emblem.
shrine:Kema Kosassa Shrine: (Unverified) Test of Strength: use ancient or heavy weapons and shield parries to beat the Guardian Scout IV.
shrine:Kema Zoos Shrine: Freeze the metal ball once on the launcher, then unfreeze it to knock it forward; dress for heat or cold. Altar gives a Spirit Orb.
shrine:Keo Ruug Shrine: Constellation puzzle: count each constellation on the far wall mural and drop orbs into matching sockets. First gate 5-3-1-2, chest gate 4-2-2-1 (left to right).
shrine:Ketoh Wawai Shrine: Shrouded Shrine: in the dark Thyphlo Ruins, light the bird sconces, beat the sleeping Hinox, and put the sphere on the glowing platform. Inside, chest has an Ancient Core.
shrine:Kiah Toza Shrine: (Unverified) DLC Trial shrine: after the plateau shrines, enter and clear the trial. Solve the puzzle to reach the chest and monk.
shrine:Kihiro Moh Shrine: DLC Pack 2 shrine in Yiga Hideout. Use Magnesis on blocks, put three metal orbs on receptacles, and grab the Thunderspear chest.
shrine:Korgu Chideh Shrine: Eventide Island: no puzzle inside. Open the chest for a Gold Rupee, then talk to the monk. The shrine appears only after finishing Stranded on Eventide.
shrine:Korsh O'hu Shrine: Open the chest for the Flamespear and take the Spirit Orb. After Forbidden City Entry quest, the Seven Heroines clue is solved in East Gerudo Ruins.
shrine:Kuh Takkar Shrine: Melt the ice with fire (Flamebreaker armor helps), lift the cube and climb the slope to the monk to open the bars.
shrine:Kuhn Sidajj Shrine: Quest solution: use Magnesis in Korok Forest and put iron objects (e.g. the chest/shield) into the mouths of the marked trees; the shrine rises and the chest has an Amber.
shrine:Lakna Rokee Shrine: No puzzle: open the chest and talk to the monk. Appears via The Stolen Heirloom; a Yiga Blademaster ambushes you on the platform first.
shrine:Lanno Kooh Shrine: Blessing shrine: swim down the river under the hill east of Lake Hebra and enter. Just walk to the monk for the Spirit Orb.
shrine:Maag Halan Shrine: Test of Wood: talk to Damia in Korok Forest, then reach Mido Swamp shrine carrying Korok sword, bow and shield without breaking them or falling in the bog. Chest: Giant Ancient Core.
shrine:Maag No'rah Shrine: (Unverified) Shoot a bomb arrow at the breakable wall near the cliff cave, then solve the puzzle inside using the Sheikah Slate runes.
shrine:Mah Eliya Shrine: (Unverified) DLC (Champions' Ballad). Appears via Mipha's Song ring chase north of Lulu Lake; use Magnesis and Stasis on the boxes to cross. Reward: Ruta's Emblem.
shrine:Maka Rah Shrine: Combat shrine: defeat the Guardian Scout I. Glide from the Lake Kilsie geyser to the cave entrance NE of the shrine.
shrine:Mezza Lo Shrine: Raised by The Crowned Beast: ride the white buck to Kass's pedestal in Rabia Plain. Ancient Trifecta puzzle: bounce the laser into switches to rotate platforms; chest has Thunderblade.
shrine:Mijah Rokee Shrine: Combat trial. Beat the Guardian Scout III (use pillars as cover, dodge lasers); chest holds a Frostblade. Appears during a Blood Moon, so stand on the pedestal with no armor.
shrine:Mirro Shaz Shrine: (Unverified) Eldin combat/puzzle shrine; use fire and the Sheikah Slate runes to open the gates, then speak with the monk at the altar.
shrine:Misae Suma Shrine: (Unverified) Blessing shrine; solve The Perfect Drink clue and talk to the monk for a Spirit Orb; chest holds a Diamond.
shrine:Mo'a Keet Shrine: Metal Makes a Path: Stasis the first boulder, then walk up the ramp holding the metal boulder in front of you, keeping distance so the rolling boulders push toward the altar.
shrine:Mogg Latan Shrine: Magnesis puzzle with swinging metal platforms: rock the chain platforms to cross, pull blocks to build a path, burn the foliage, then push the gate open. Chests: bow, spear, Gold Rupee.
shrine:Monya Toma Shrine: Launcher puzzle: drop the orb in the first launcher so it chains onward, shoot the crystal switch, then ride a launcher to the far platform. Chest holds a Thunderblade.
shrine:Mozo Shenno Shrine: Test of Strength: defeat a Guardian Scout IV. Dodge its attacks and parry its beam. Part of The Bird in the Mountains quest.
shrine:Muwo Jeem Shrine: (Unverified) Combat trial: defeat the Guardian Scout III (shock-stun it with arrows, hit weak points), then collect the chest and talk to the monk.
shrine:Myahm Agana Shrine: Motion-control maze: tilt the controller to roll the ball through the maze to the exit; the chest holds the Phrenic Bow. Switch Pro/handheld gyro on.
shrine:Namika Ozz Shrine: Combat trial in a hollow stump: fight the Guardian Scout III, using pillars as cover and dodging lasers. Chest holds a Frostspear.
shrine:Ne'ez Yohma Shrine: (Unverified) Pushing Power: roll the orb down the slope into its socket in Zora's Domain, freezing boulders with Cryonis/Stasis. Chest has a Zora Spear.
shrine:Noe Rajee Shrine: (Unverified) DLC Trial shrine: after the plateau shrines, enter and clear the trial. Solve the puzzle to reach the chest and monk.
shrine:Noya Neha Shrine: Combat trial: bomb the cracked wall/burn the thorns to enter, then beat Guardian Scout II. Chest holds a Knight's Shield.
shrine:Oman Au Shrine: Magnesis tutorial: grab the rune, pull the metal floor door open, and use Magnesis to grab the left chest (Traveler's Bow) before the exit gate.
shrine:Owa Daim Shrine: Stasis trial: grab the Stasis Rune from the pedestal, then freeze the spinning slab or boulder to cross. Use the Iron Sledgehammer chest to smash obstacles.
shrine:Pumaag Nitae Shrine: Combat shrine: defeat the Guardian Scout II. Use pillars for cover and a Guardian-resistant shield against its spin and laser. Chest near the altar after the fight.
shrine:Qaza Tokki Shrine: Complete the maze to reach the chest holding Barbarian Leg Wraps. Blessing monk is at the end.
shrine:Qua Raym Shrine: Balance scales: shoot the wooden crate to drop it on a scale, put a metal cube on the shrine-side platform, then place the chest and other cube opposite to balance. Reach via Magnesis bridge over Goronbi Lake.
shrine:Qukah Nata Shrine: Opened via A Song of Storms. No puzzle inside: walk to the monk, open the chest for Rubber Tights (lightning protection).
shrine:Raqa Zunzo Shrine: After Vah Naboris, solve The Undefeated Champ clue and talk to the monk; chest holds a Radiant Shield.
shrine:Ree Dahee Shrine: (Unverified) Puzzle shrine; the optional chest holds the Climber's Bandanna. Use Magnesis/Stasis on the metal objects to open the path to the altar.
shrine:Rin Oyaa Shrine: Ball-and-platform puzzle: roll the ball onto the platform. Shield bomb jumps or Stasis can skip parts. Found under a rock near Snowfield Stable.
shrine:Rinu Honika Shrine: DLC Block the Blaze: Magnesis and flip the metal platform about 90 degrees to shield from the flames, then cross. Climb the ladder for a Stone Smasher chest.
shrine:Ritaag Zumo Shrine: No puzzle. Chest holds a Giant Ancient Core; talk to the monk for the Spirit Orb. Appears after placing the Ancient Orb on the pedestal (Into the Vortex).
shrine:Rohta Chigah Shrine: EX shrine, one-hit-kill mode: block the spike wall with a metal plate via Magnesis, avoid the floor button, and climb a non-spiked pillar to the monk.
shrine:Rok Uwog Shrine: Puzzle shrine: use the metal chest in the first room (Magnesis) to get the key. Stasis or Octo Balloons can skip it.
shrine:Rona Kachta Shrine: (Unverified) Puzzle shrine: use the Sheikah Slate runes (Magnesis or Stasis) on the platforms to reach the exit.
shrine:Rota Ooh Shrine: Gates and orb puzzle: shoot the arrow switch, grab the small key, put the Ancient Orb in the basket to power a launcher, then glide to the altar. Chest holds a Feathered Edge.
shrine:Rucco Maag Shrine: (Unverified) Light all five torches with fire arrows, working the switches to open the barrier. Chests hold an Opal and a Silver Bow; burn the platforms or use Magnesis.
shrine:Ruvo Korbah Shrine: EX shrine: defeat the Guardian Scouts in the arena to open the gate. Chest holds Bomb Arrows. Shrine rises after clearing the Lizalfos camp (Champions' Ballad).
shrine:Saas Ko'sah Shrine: Combat trial: Guardian Scout IV (3000 HP). Lift the floor metal blocks with Magnesis as shields. Chest holds a Flameblade; light the big torch outside to unlock it.
shrine:Sah Dahaj Shrine: Power of Fire: burn the dry leaves with a lamp or fire arrow so a slab falls on the switch and opens the door. Burning them also drops the chest (Knight's Bow).
shrine:Sasa Kai Shrine: Combat shrine: fight a Guardian Scout III in the arena, using the pillars to dodge its spin attack. Chest holds the Frostblade. Unlocked by the Sign of the Shadow quest.
shrine:Sato Koda Shrine: DLC: use Cryonis to freeze a block at the end of the ramp and another under the left see-saw side, then reach the altar on the right. Chest above ball path: Giant Ancient Core.
shrine:Sha Gehma Shrine: Horizontal moving platform puzzle: ride platforms to get the key. Octo Balloons on the metal block skip it.
shrine:Sha Warvo Shrine: Combat shrine: defeat the Guardian Scout I. Dodge, then hit its eye.
shrine:Shada Naw Shrine: Metal box and ball puzzle: use Magnesis on the metal item in the left wall, then roll the ball into the hole. Bomb arrows can hit the ball.
shrine:Shae Katha Shrine: Opened via The Serpent's Jaws: offer Farosh's Scale at the Spring of Courage statue. No puzzle inside: walk to the monk; chest holds a Thunderspear.
shrine:Shae Loya Shrine: (Unverified) Bow puzzle: shoot the targets with arrows to open the doors and reach the monk.
shrine:Shae Mo'sah Shrine: Swinging Flames: step on the floor switch, Stasis the flames and run through; the ball hits the mill wheel to open the next door. Chests: Stone Smasher, Ruby.
shrine:Shai Utoh Shrine: Bomb the rock wall behind Lakeside Stable to enter. Use Stasis to lock the tilting ramps and platforms, climb up, then freeze the final platform to reach the monk.
shrine:Shai Yota Shrine: No puzzle inside. Appears after Master of the Wind; chest has a Great Flameblade, then talk to the monk for the Spirit Orb.
shrine:Sharo Lun Shrine: (Unverified) DLC (Daruk's Song): glide through the rings near Death Mountain's top to spawn it. Ride the metal crate across the room, avoid flames. Reward: Rudania's Emblem.
shrine:Shee Vaneer Shrine: (Unverified) Twin Memories: memorize the orb positions shown here, then use them as the answer in Shee Venath (and vice versa). Chest on upper left reachable by paraglide (Edge of Duality).
shrine:Shee Venath Shrine: (Unverified) Memory puzzle: reproduce the orb pattern remembered from Shee Vaneer. Place the orbs on the matching pedestals; do Shee Vaneer first.
shrine:Sheem Dagoze Shrine: Ball-and-ramp puzzle: use floor switches to roll the balls into the slots and adjust the ramps. Glide to the central area for a chest; reward includes a Great Thunderblade.
shrine:Sheh Rata Shrine: Speed of Light: burn the brambles to enter, glide to the far doorway and put the metal barrel on the switch. Detonate the remote bomb to raise the water, Cryonis to reach the Giant Boomerang chest.
shrine:Shira Gomar Shrine: (Unverified) DLC Trial shrine: after the plateau shrines, enter and clear the trial. Solve the puzzle to reach the chest and monk.
shrine:Sho Dantu Shrine: Break a Luminous Stone deposit nearby and drop a stone on the platform to raise the shrine. Inside, solve the Remote Bomb puzzle (blow up crates and walls); talk to the monk for the orb.
shrine:Shoda Sah Shrine: Behind the Riola Spring waterfall. Launch glowing balls from the left launcher to knock a Small Key chest across, then unlock the gate. Right launcher gives Ice Arrows.
shrine:Shoqa Tatone Shrine: Opened via Guardian Slideshow. Beat the Guardian Scout, using pillars to dodge its spin and laser. Chest near the altar holds a Royal Broadsword.
shrine:Shora Hah Shrine: Blue Flame: ignite the torches with blue flame using fire arrows or a spin attack in the center; ride the mine cart (bomb in its compartment) to reach it. Many chests inside.
shrine:Shrine of Resurrection: (Unverified) After the four Divine Beasts, place the Sheikah Slate on the pedestal to reach the hidden trial and defeat Monk Maz Koshia to unlock the Master Cycle Zero.
shrine:Soh Kofi Shrine: Combat trial: defeat the Guardian Scout II (dodge or parry its lasers). Chest in the altar room has a Knight's Bow. Glide down from the north side of Lanayru Tower.
shrine:Suma Sahma Shrine: (Unverified) Opened via Secret of the Snowy Peaks; the shrine sits in a cold area, so bring cold protection. Reach the monk at the end.
shrine:Ta'loh Naeg Shrine: (Unverified) Puzzle shrine in Kakariko; chests hold an Opal, a Shield of the Mind's Eye and an Eightfold Blade. Use Magnesis/Stasis to reach each chest.
shrine:Tah Muhl Shrine: Landscape of a Stable: the shrine is under the birds in Mayro's painting, southwest of Foothill Stable. Inside, burn the vines and crates with a torch; chest has Cobble Crusher.
shrine:Tahno O'ah Shrine: No puzzle. Reach the three cedars on Madorna Mountain (bring cold resistance) and bomb the entrance; chest holds Climbing Boots.
shrine:Takama Shiri Shrine: (Unverified) Champions' Ballad shrine: ride through the glowing rings (beware electric Lizalfos) to raise it. Use Magnesis on metal blocks to bridge gaps and route current to the gate.
shrine:Tawa Jinn Shrine: No puzzle: grab the Great Thunderblade chest and talk to the monk. Appears after placing three orbs from The Three Giant Brothers quest.
shrine:Tena Ko'sah Shrine: Test of Strength: fight a Guardian Scout IV. Dodge its attacks and parry its beam.
shrine:Tho Kayu Shrine: Beat the Molduga, then light the four torches on the surrounding rock platforms with fire arrows to raise the shrine. Inside is a single room, just talk to the monk.
shrine:To Quomo Shrine: Blessing shrine SE of Hebra North Summit: use Cryonis to make two ice pillars on the pond, then roll the snowball uphill to break the doors.
shrine:Toh Yahsa Shrine: Enter Thundra Plateau to start Trial of Thunder; Stasis/launch the orbs onto their pedestals to raise the shrine. Chests hold Rubber Armor (shock-proof); Magnesis the metal cube inside.
shrine:Toto Sah Shrine: (Unverified) Gyro (motion control) puzzle: tilt/aim the controller to guide the ball or platform to the goal; the chest is optional.
shrine:Tu Ka'loh Shrine: Appears after Trial of the Labyrinth. No puzzle: walk in, open the chest for the Barbarian Helm, then talk to the monk.
shrine:Tutsuwa Nima Shrine: Opens by dropping Dinraal's Scale before the Goddess Statue. Inside: fight Guardian Scout IV; parry its spin attack to stun it, then hit it.
shrine:Voo Lota Shrine: (Unverified) After Vah Medoh, finish Recital at Warbler's Nest to raise it. Inside it's a winding-route puzzle; take the path to the monk.
shrine:Wahgo Katta Shrine: Magnesis puzzle: stack the metal crates into a tower, then lay the metal slab as a bridge to the monk's ledge.
shrine:Ya Naga Shrine: Drop a round Remote Bomb in the funnel so it rolls under the stone block, stand on the block and detonate to rise. Paraglide to the side pillar for the Eightfold Blade chest.
shrine:Yah Rin Shrine: Combat trial: beat the Guardian Scout II (Scout III in Master Mode) with arrow stuns and parries, then take the chest and talk to the monk.
shrine:Yowaka Ita Shrine: (Unverified) DLC shrine, available once the Divine Beast Tamer's Trial is activated. Solve it as a normal shrine to claim the Spirit Orb.
shrine:Zalta Wa Shrine: Orb puzzle: shoot the right orb into its receptacle to open the gate, carry the second orb to the left switch, drop it in the receptacle, then use the launcher and moving platform. Chest: Knight's Bow.
shrine:Ze Kasho Shrine: Motion-control (gyro) puzzle: tilt the platform to hit the laser switches, climb the rotating block, then place three orbs on three tile switches to open the gate. Silverscale Spear reward.
shrine:Zuna Kai Shrine: Atop an eye of Skull Lake (after Robbie's Research). No puzzle: walk to the chest (Flameblade), then talk to the monk.
side-quest:A Freezing Rod: Show Kula at the Great Deku Tree an Ice Rod or Blizz Rod (Ice Wizzrobe drop). Silver or Gold Rupee reward; you keep the rod.
side-quest:A Gift for My Beloved: Talk to Manny in Hateno, then ask Prima at the Great Ton Pu Inn. Catch 10 Restless Crickets in the grass nearby and give them to Manny for a Silver Rupee.
side-quest:A Gift for the Great Fairy: Toren gives you 500 rupees to offer the Great Fairy at the fountain near Tabantha Tower (west across the bridge). Pay her, then return to Toren.
side-quest:A Gift from the Monks: After all 120 shrines, warp to Rona Kachta Shrine in the Forgotten Temple; open the three chests behind it for the Cap, Tunic and Trousers of the Wild.
side-quest:A Gift of Nightshade: Talk to Wabbin at the heart-shaped pond atop Tuft Mountain. Bring him a Blue Nightshade (west shore of Yambi Lake), then agree to pass it on to the woman for rupees.
side-quest:A Parent's Love: At night, eavesdrop at the south house's window in Tarrey Town. Cook a Monster Cake (monster part, plus ingredients) and give it to Ruli.
side-quest:A Rare Find: (Unverified) Bring Raw Gourmet Meat to Trott at Outskirt Stable and hand it over for the reward.
side-quest:A Royal Recipe: (Unverified) Talk to Gotter at Riverside Stable and bring him the dish or ingredients he asks for.
side-quest:A Shady Customer: Hoz at East Akkala Stable asks for a photo of Kilton. Photograph him at Skull Lake's eye with the Camera Rune, show Hoz; Kilton becomes a vendor.
side-quest:A Wife Washed Away: After Vah Ruta, talk to Fronk in Zora's Domain, then find his wife Mei fishing at Lake Hylia and talk to her. Reward: 5 Staminoka Bass.
side-quest:An Ice Guy: Give Guy, the Rito at Kara Kara Bazaar, a Chilly Elixir (cook a Cold Darner or Winterwing Butterfly with a monster part) for a Purple Rupee.
side-quest:Arrows of Burning Heat: Talk to Rola in Kakariko. Light the four torches around the Goddess Statue using fire arrows (buy from Rola or light arrows at the campfire). Reward: rupees.
side-quest:Balloon Flight: Talk to Shamae at Woodland Stable by day, then attach two Octo Balloons (Octorok drops) to the nearby barrel to float it. Reward is a Star Fragment.
side-quest:By Firefly's Light: Talk to Lasli in her house at night (after Flown the Coop). Catch five Sunset Fireflies and release them in her house for a Purple Rupee.
side-quest:Cooking with Koko: Talk to Koko in Kakariko by day. Buy Goat Butter from the nearby shop and give it to her; reward is a Hot Buttered Apple and it opens Koko Cuisine.
side-quest:Curry for What Ails You: Bring Goron Spice (Goron City shop or Yammo) to Lester at Rito Stable for a Purple Rupee; he'll trade rice for more spice.
side-quest:Death Mountain's Secret: Talk to Dugby at Goron Hot Springs by day, then bomb the odd-coloured rock wall in the crags near the Bridge of Eldin to find a Drillshaft; Dugby lets you keep it.
side-quest:Diving is Beauty!: Talk to Gruve atop the waterfall by the throne room (needs Zora Armor). Jump off the ledge where he stands, swim back up the falls with the armor, and report back for Fleet-Lotus Seeds.
side-quest:EX Ancient Horse Rumors: (Unverified) Read the Super Rumor Mill EX at Highland Stable and follow its clues to find the Ancient Saddle and Bridle (Champions' Ballad DLC).
side-quest:EX Royal Guard Rumors: DLC quest: read Super Rumor Mill EX Vol. 4 at Riverside Stable, then collect Royal Guard Cap, Uniform and Boots in Hyrule Castle (Guards' Chamber, library hallway).
side-quest:EX Strange Mask Rumors: (Unverified) Master Trials DLC: talk to the Super Rumor Mill at stables for the mask rumor, then follow its hint to find the hidden Majora's Mask.
side-quest:EX Teleportation Rumors: (Unverified) Master Trials DLC: talk to Super Rumor Mill V2 at South Akkala Stable and follow its hint to find the Travel Medallion, letting you teleport back to a placed point.
side-quest:EX Treasure: Ancient Mask: Read Misko's EX Journal at Outpost Ruins, then go to Kolomo Garrison Ruins and pull the buried chest from the debris at the south corner with Magnesis for Majora's Mask.
side-quest:EX Treasure: Dark Armor: (Unverified) Read Misko's EX Journal clue for the Dark Armor and dig up the buried treasure chest at the hinted ruin with Magnesis.
side-quest:EX Treasure: Fairy Clothes: Read Misko's EX Journal clue; find Fairy Hood at Exchange Ruins and Fairy Clothes at Prison Ruins (Magnesis to lift buried chests).
side-quest:EX Treasure: Garb of Winds: (Unverified) Read Misko's journal at Deya Village Ruins, follow its clue to the buried chest and dig it up for the Island Lobster Shirt (heat resistance).
side-quest:EX Treasure: Merchant Hood: Read Misko's journal at Deya Village Ruins south of the Hills of Baumer; dig up the chest under the Dragon Statue's hand for Ravio's Hood.
side-quest:EX Treasure: Phantasma: Read Misko's journal at Outpost Ruins east of the Great Plateau Tower; the Phantom armor chests are at Coliseum, Sacred Ground and Hyrule Garrison Ruins.
side-quest:EX Treasure: Twilight Relic: (Unverified) Find Misko's journal, follow its clue to the buried chest and dig it up for Midna's Helmet (Guardian resistance up).
side-quest:EX Treasure: Usurper King: (Unverified) Find Misko's journal, follow the picture clue to the buried chest and dig it up for the Majora's Mask reward.
side-quest:EX Trial of the Sword: Master Trials DLC: after The Hero's Sword, return the Master Sword to its pedestal and clear the three Trial of the Sword sets (no gear) to upgrade it. Save first and bring max hearts.
side-quest:Face the Frost Talus: After Vah Medoh, talk to Gesane on the bridge by Rito Stable. Kill the Frost Talus at Coldsnap Hollow (bring fire arrows, shoot its weak spot), then report back.
side-quest:Find Kheel: After Vah Medoh, talk to Amali on the bridge in Rito Village. Find her daughter Kheel at Warbler's Nest, talk to her, then return to Amali.
side-quest:Fireproof Lizard Roundup: Bring Kima at Southern Mine 10 Fireproof Lizards (sneak up on them under rocks) for the Flamebreaker Armor. Afterwards she pays rupees for 3 more.
side-quest:Flown the Coop: Talk to Cado in Kakariko. Catch the seven escaped cuccos around town and carry or toss them into the coop; then talk to Cado for a Purple Rupee.
side-quest:Frog Catching: After Vah Ruta, talk to Tumbo near the fountain in Zora's Domain. Sneak up and catch 5 Hot-Footed Frogs (common around Zora's Domain), then return for an Armoranth.
side-quest:From the Ground Up: Own your Hateno house, then talk to Hudson. Deliver wood as asked (about 110 bundles total, 50 for the wedding), plus help bring Gerudo and Goron guests; reward 3 Diamonds.
side-quest:Good-Sized Horse: Talk to Zyle in Gerudo Canyon, then bring him a normal-sized horse (not the giant one) and hand it over for 300 rupees. Don't give up a horse you want.
side-quest:Hobbies of the Rich: Talk to Hagie in Tarrey Town, defeat two Guardian Stalkers in Torin Wetland, then return for payment.
side-quest:Hunt for the Giant Horse: Talk to Straia at the Mounted Archery Camp, then sneak up on the Giant Horse in Taobab Grasslands, calm it (bring stamina food) and bring it back.
side-quest:Hylian Homeowner: Talk to Bolson at the southern edge of Hateno Village, then pay 3,000 rupees and hand over 30 wood to buy the house. Talk to him again for furniture upgrades.
side-quest:Koko Cuisine: After Cooking with Koko, give Koko in Kakariko Village a Raw Meat (afternoon, dry weather) so she can make Tough Meat-Stuffed Pumpkin.
side-quest:Koko's Kitchen: Give Koko a Swift Carrot at her cooking pot by the General Store in Kakariko (about noon to 7pm, no rain). She cooks Hasty Veggie Cream Soup and starts her recipe chain.
side-quest:Koko's Specialty: After Koko Cuisine, give Koko a Courser Bee Honey in Kakariko (afternoon). Find honey in bee hives near East Hill; she makes Energizing Honeyed Apple.
side-quest:Legendary Rabbit Trial: Talk to Peeks at the Great Deku Tree, then photograph a Blupee (glowing blue rabbit, usually at night) with the Camera Rune and show him. Silver Rupee reward.
side-quest:Leviathan Bones: Needs Camera Rune. Photograph the three leviathan skeletons (Eldin, Hebra, Gerudo) and show Akrah and brothers at Serenne Stable for 300 rupees.
side-quest:Little Sister's Big Request: Give Jana an Armoranth, then bring Gleema a Warm, Cold and Electric Darner. Return to Jana at South Akkala Stable for a Silver Rupee.
side-quest:Luminous Stone Gathering: Talk to Ledo in Zora's Domain after Vah Ruta. Mine Luminous Stone ore with bombs or a smasher (Upland Zorana is rich) and bring stones; he pays Diamonds per 10 stones.
side-quest:Lynel Safari: Needs Camera Rune. Talk to Laflat in Zora's Domain, then photograph a Lynel on the mountain east of the Domain (best after killing it, before it vanishes). Reward: Zora Greaves.
side-quest:Medicinal Molduga: Talk to Malena in Gerudo Town, kill a Molduga in the desert and bring her its Molduga Guts. Required for The Thunder Helm.
side-quest:Misko, the Great Bandit: Pay Domidak 100 rupees at Dueling Peaks Stable for the hint, then bomb the wall atop the waterfall near Hickaly Woods; chest holds Misko's treasure.
side-quest:Missing in Action: Talk to Sesami at Gerudo Canyon Stable, then free four travelers (Oliff, Flaxel, Canolo, Palme) from monsters north of Koukot Plateau. Report back for a Gold Rupee.
side-quest:My Hero: Talk to Aliza near Outskirt Stable, then show her the Master Sword (after pulling it) for a Star Fragment. Auto-completes if you already have it.
side-quest:Playtime with Cottla: Talk to Cottla in Kakariko (about 11am-4pm), pick hide-and-seek, then find her behind Impa's House and talk to her for Rock Salt.
side-quest:Riddles of Hyrule: Walton at the Great Deku Tree: answers are Apple, Fortified Pumpkin, Sunshroom, Voltfin Trout, Lynel Hoof; show each to him in turn. Reward is a Diamond.
side-quest:Riverbed Reward: Talk to Izra by Wetland Stable, then use Magnesis to pull the treasure chest out of the river and set it before her. Keep the sword inside.
side-quest:Robbie's Research: After Locked Mementos, ask Purah about Robbie, then go to Akkala Ancient Tech Lab. Carry blue flame from the nearby local furnace and light Robbie's furnace to finish; reward is Ancient Arrows.
side-quest:Rushroom Rush!: (Unverified) Talk to Pirou at Gerudo Canyon Stable (daytime) and bring him the Rushrooms he asks for (55 per the quest requirement) for a rupee reward.
side-quest:Slated for Upgrades: Talk to Purah at Hateno lab after Locked Mementos. Bring 3 Ancient Screws, 3 Ancient Shafts and 3 Ancient Cores to upgrade Sensor+, Remote Bomb+ and Stasis+.
side-quest:Special Delivery: After Vah Ruta, take Finley's love letter at the Bank of Wishes and follow it down the river (Lizalfos en route) to Sasan in Zora's Domain. Reward: Gold Rupee.
side-quest:Stalhorse: Pictured!: Needs Camera Rune. Photograph a Stalhorse at night in the eastern North Tabantha Snowfield near the ruins, then show Juannelle at Snowfield Stable.
side-quest:Sunken Treasure: Talk to Rozel in Lurelin Village, dive in the bay between the three rocks and use Magnesis to raise the chest.
side-quest:Sunshroom Sensing: Talk to Symin in Hateno lab (needs Sensor+). Photograph the Sunshroom behind the lab, then find 3 Sunshrooms (Retsam Forest) with the sensor and bring them for 3 Hearty Truffles.
side-quest:Take Back the Sea: Accept Sebasto's request in Lurelin Village, then defeat all Bokoblins and the Moblin on Aris Beach to the southwest. Open the chest (Knight's Halberd) and report back for a Silver Rupee.
side-quest:The Apple of My Eye: Give Juney (Rito Village, upper walkway) a Baked Apple; roast an apple over a fire. She pays rupees.
side-quest:The Eighth Heroine: Wear the Gerudo outfit and talk to Bozai outside Gerudo Town. Photograph the Eighth Heroine statue in the Gerudo Highlands with the Camera rune and show him for Snow Boots.
side-quest:The Forgotten Sword: After The Eighth Heroine, talk to Bozai at noon in the Gerudo outfit. Photograph the Eighth Heroine statue's missing sword (Master Sword location) and show him for Snow Boots.
side-quest:The Giant of Ralis Pond: After Vah Ruta, talk to Torfeau in Zora's Domain, then defeat the Hinox at Ralis Pond (southwest of the Domain) and return for a Silver Rupee.
side-quest:The Hero's Cache: Listen to Kass's song at Kitano Bay, then use Magnesis in the water at the spot it describes to pull up the hidden chest (Gold Rupee).
side-quest:The Horseback Hoodlums: Talk to Perosa at Highland Stable, then kill the five mounted Blue Bokoblins just northwest of it and report back for an Endura Carrot.
side-quest:The Jewel Trade: After Vah Rudania, bring Ramella in Goron City the 10 Amber she asks for (500 rupees). She buys other gems in tens afterwards.
side-quest:The Korok Trials: Talk to Chio in Korok Forest and complete Trial of Second Sight, The Lost Pilgrimage and The Test of Wood. Return for three Big Heart Truffles.
side-quest:The Mystery Polluter: After starting The Thunder Helm, talk to Dalia in Gerudo Town's north alley by day. Follow the melon rinds to Calyban on the wall and give him 10 Wildberries.
side-quest:The Priceless Maracas: Talk to Hestu in West Necluda, clear the Bokoblin camp just uphill, grab the Maracas and return them to Hestu.
side-quest:The Road to Respect: Talk to Fugo in Goron City, defeat the Igneo Talus at Darunia Lake (northeast of Shae Mo'sah Shrine), then report back for rupees.
side-quest:The Royal Guard's Gear: Talk to Parcy in Riverside Stable, then fetch any Royal Guard weapon (claymore, spear, sword, bow, shield) from Hyrule Castle and show her for a Gold Rupee.
side-quest:The Royal White Stallion: Talk to Toffa at Outskirt Stable, tame the white horse on Safula Hill (needs stamina and stealth), register it at the stable and talk to Toffa for the Royal Saddle/Bridle.
side-quest:The Search for Barta: After starting The Thunder Helm, talk to Liana in the Gerudo Town barracks. Bring a Hearty Durian to Barta, collapsed in the desert, then report to Liana for a Silver Rupee.
side-quest:The Secret Club's Secret: Try the locked door behind Fashion Passion in Gerudo Town and tell Greta the password (GSC plus a diamond symbol, from Yaido). A wrong guess locks you out until the next day.
side-quest:The Sheep Rustlers: Talk to Koyin in Hateno Village, clear every monster at the Hateno Beach camp, open the chest for a Ruby, then return to Koyin for 10 Fresh Milk.
side-quest:The Spark of Romance: Bring Jogo (Rito Village inn) a Flint; mine it from ore deposits near the village entrance bridges. Reward: a Silver Rupee.
side-quest:The Statue's Bargain: Talk to the Horned Statue just north of Firly Pond (Teebo can guide you). Swap a heart for stamina or vice versa; the first swap is free and completes the quest.
side-quest:The Thunder Helm: Tell Riju you want the helm, then finish Tools of the Trade, Medicinal Molduga, The Mystery Polluter and The Search for Barta (start Thunder Helm first). Return to Riju for it.
side-quest:The Weapon Connoisseur: Show Nebb in Hateno Village each weapon on his list (Traveler's Sword, Fire Rod, Moblin Club, Duplex Bow, Windcleaver, Ancient Battle Axe+, Frostspear, Ancient Short Sword) for a Diamond.
side-quest:Thunder Magnet: Talk to Cima at Lakeside Stable, pull the Woodcutter's Axe off the stable roof's horse nose with Magnesis, and return it for the Rubber Helm.
side-quest:Tools of the Trade: Talk to Isha in Gerudo Town and bring her 10 Flint for a rupee reward. Required for The Thunder Helm.
side-quest:What's for Dinner?: Bring Kiana in Lurelin Village (daytime) Goat Butter (sold in Kakariko) and a Hearty Blueshell Snail (found on beaches) to get 50 rupees and a dinner invite.
side-quest:Wild Horses: Accept Rensa's challenge outside Dueling Peaks Stable, tame a wild horse southeast near Bubinga Forest and ride it back within 2 minutes for a Purple Rupee. Spotted horses are easier.
side-quest:Zora Stone Monuments: Talk to Jiahto in Zora's Domain, then read all 10 stone monuments around the area (no photos needed, any order); the last is on Upland Zorana's southeast cliff. Reward: Diamond.
